topics.title: Mathematical foundations and proof
topics.summary: A gentle toolkit for reading definitions, making conjectures, finding counterexamples, and writing finite proofs.

topics.title: Logic and set theory
topics.summary: Precise statements, quantifiers, sets, functions, and infinity, with semantics kept distinct from proof syntax.

topics.title: Number theory
topics.summary: Divisibility, primes, congruences, and elementary cryptographic ideas through proof and play.

topics.title: Combinatorics
topics.summary: Count without double counting, discover recurrences, and use generating functions as a deeper optional route.

topics.title: Graph theory
topics.summary: Reason about networks, paths, colourings, trees, and planar structure.

topics.title: Theoretical computer science
topics.summary: Finite machines, algorithmic cost, and rigorous limits of computation.

courses.title: Structure of finite graphs
courses.capstone: Analyze two network drawings for isomorphism and planarity, explaining every invariant used.
courses.assessment: Three short written proofs with one counterexample to a false converse.

courses.title: Machines and instructions
courses.capstone: Design a two-state reminder machine and specify its accepted strings.
courses.assessment: Trace tables and a termination/correctness checklist.

courses.title: Algorithms with reasons
prerequisites: proof by induction and basic logarithms
courses.capstone: Compare search strategies on a sorted archive and prove the stated cost.
courses.assessment: Loop-invariant proof and recurrence solution; timings treated as illustration.

courses.title: Limits of mechanical reasoning
outcomes: Explain the status of P versus NP
courses.capstone: Write a public explanation of why a universal halting checker fails, with exact machine assumptions.
courses.assessment: Formal diagonal argument, two definition checks, and open-problem communication rubric.

labs.title: Conjecture stress test
labs.readout: Truth value and substitution for each tested input; claim scope shown.
labs.invariant: A single counterexample refutes a universal claim; passing finite cases does not prove it.
labs.pitfalls: Do not label a long successful search as proof.
labs.accessibleFallback: Form fields, ordered results table, and textual substitution; all actions keyboard operable.

labs.title: Base and step builder
labs.readout: Current formula, base calculation, and symbolic step with assumptions separated.
labs.invariant: The induction hypothesis is available only at earlier indices.
labs.pitfalls: Animation alone cannot establish all n; prevent circular use of target.
labs.accessibleFallback: Static numbered proof obligations and text equations; reduced motion switch.

labs.title: Quantifier order grid
labs.readout: Truth of both quantified sentences and explicit witness or failing case.
labs.invariant: Truth follows the selected finite relation and current quantifier scopes.
labs.pitfalls: Finite models can refute equivalence but cannot prove it generally.
labs.accessibleFallback: Keyboard editable relation table with plain-text witnesses and failures.

labs.title: The missed binary sequence
labs.readout: Diagonal bits and first differing position for every visible row.
labs.invariant: Constructed nth bit differs from nth listed sequence bit.
labs.pitfalls: A finite grid illustrates the infinite proof; never claim it exhausts all sequences.
labs.accessibleFallback: Accessible numbered table and algorithm stated in text.

labs.title: Euclid in rectangles
labs.readout: Remainder table, gcd, quotient sequence, and Bezout coefficients.
labs.invariant: The set of common divisors is unchanged by (a,b)→(b,a mod b).
labs.pitfalls: Handle zero endpoint and forbid division by zero; tiles are an analogy.
labs.accessibleFallback: Numeric division ledger and keyboard step buttons.

labs.title: Clock orbits and inverses
labs.readout: Orbit, multiplication table, gcd(a,m), and inverse if it exists.
labs.invariant: Multiplication permutes residues exactly when gcd(a,m)=1.
labs.pitfalls: A visible orbit alone is not a proof for every modulus.
labs.accessibleFallback: Text table with highlighted collisions and inverse value.

labs.title: Choice tree and overcount
labs.readout: Ordered count, unordered count when valid, and explicit outcome list.
labs.invariant: Each ordered path represents one sequence; unordered groups have k! labelings only for distinct picks.
labs.pitfalls: No division by k! when repetition or symmetry changes multiplicity.
labs.accessibleFallback: Nested text list of choices and count formula; keyboard controls.

labs.title: Overlap ledger
controls: Toggle memberships for up to 12 elements
labs.readout: Region counts and every signed term in inclusion–exclusion.
labs.invariant: Each element contributes exactly one to the union total.
labs.pitfalls: Venn geometry must not imply area-proportional counts.
labs.accessibleFallback: Membership table and arithmetic ledger with textual per-element contributions.

labs.title: Edge degrees and routes
labs.readout: Adjacency list, degree sum, edge count, and route status.
labs.invariant: For simple graphs sum degrees=2E; Euler criterion requires connected nonisolated part.
labs.pitfalls: Disconnected even-degree examples must fail circuit claim; loops excluded.
labs.accessibleFallback: Keyboard adjacency editor and ordered trail as text.

labs.title: Shortest path layers
labs.readout: Queue, discovered vertices, distance labels, and predecessor path.
labs.invariant: First discovery gives shortest edge-count distance in an unweighted graph.
labs.pitfalls: Weighted travel times invalidate this optimality argument.
labs.accessibleFallback: Text queue log, adjacency table, and distance list.

labs.title: Finite state machine workshop
labs.readout: State-by-state trace and accept or reject.
labs.invariant: At each symbol, exactly one transition determines the next DFA state.
labs.pitfalls: Missing transitions require an explicit reject sink or invalid-machine state.
labs.accessibleFallback: Keyboard editable transition table and text trace.

labs.title: Growth and thresholds
controls: Set constant C and threshold n0
labs.readout: Exact operation counts and whether f(n)≤Cg(n) on displayed values.
labs.invariant: A displayed finite range cannot establish an asymptotic bound.
labs.pitfalls: Avoid calling empirical run times Big O proof or hiding crossover points.
labs.accessibleFallback: Numeric table and explicit symbolic bound statement.
